findings.title: Security-scan evidence misstates CSP script-src
findings.detail: phase-6-security-scan.json sets script_src_no_unsafe_inline: true and its threat note claims script-src has no unsafe-inline, but the recorded CSP string and the real out/_headers both contain script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'. The CSP choice is correct and unavoidable for a Next.js static export (built HTML ships 4 framework inline runtime scripts; no user input, no third-party scripts, remaining directives strong), but the evidence boolean/note is factually wrong and should be corrected.

findings.title: axe incomplete color-contrast on / omitted from headline claims
findings.detail: phase-6-a11y-audit.json records incomplete: ['color-contrast'] for the home page (likely the fixed grain overlay blocking axe background resolution). '0 violations' remains accurate; reviewer manually verified all text tokens meet their applicable WCAG band (body >=8.8:1, ghost numerals 3.43:1 white / 3.26:1 canvas at >=48px display scale).

findings.title: /404 recorded as HTTP 200 in browser matrix
findings.detail: The harness static server serves out/404.html at the literal /404 path with status 200; real CDN behavior (Cloudflare Pages) returns 404 for unmatched routes. Not a site defect; the evidence should note the nuance.

findings.title: Footer year is build-time frozen
findings.detail: new Date().getFullYear() in src/components/layout/footer.tsx freezes at export time; acceptable for a static portfolio but goes stale without periodic rebuilds.

findings.title: Stale fact-whitelist entries for removed features
findings.detail: prime/state/fact-whitelist.md still documents W20 (live GitHub stats) and W26 (web3forms contact endpoint) which no longer exist in the rebuilt site (correctly removed per ADR-3.9). Documentation hygiene only.

findings.title: a11y-fix regression check passed
findings.detail: Both session fixes verified independently: zero role= attributes remain anywhere in src (presentation-on-li fully removed); all four showcase variants share ShowcaseGhostIndex now using --ghost-ink #858B94 (computed contrast 3.43:1/3.26:1, AA large-text at 48-192px); every --rule-deep/--rule usage is border/divider/background only, never text ink; docs/DESIGN.canvas.tsx updated in lockstep; out/index.html contains ghost-ink and evidence timestamps (00:41-00:49Z) postdate the fix (00:39Z) and rebuild (00:40Z). Screenshots are real full-page PNGs (1440x8397, 773KB) and one was visually inspected showing genuine rendered content. Content claims trace to whitelist entries (W2/W3/W23/W27 verbatim); no forbidden labels, no invented seniority (single honest 'Software Developer Intern' entry); all target=_blank anchors carry rel=noopener noreferrer; lang, h1 count, skip link, focus ring, reduced-motion layers, and single-theme posture all confirmed.

summary: Independent adversarial review of Phase 6: evidence is genuine and internally consistent (real Playwright/axe runs post-fix, non-trivial full-page screenshots verified on disk and visually, reconciled check counts, signed receipts). Both a11y fixes are correct and complete with no sibling occurrences (zero role= attributes in src; ghost numerals independently measured >=3:1 AA large-text; --rule-deep never used as text). Content is whitelist-traceable with no invented facts or forbidden labels; security posture is sound for a static export. Two minor evidence-annotation inaccuracies (CSP unsafe-inline misstatement in the scan JSON; omitted axe incomplete) and three nits recorded; none affect site behavior or block the phase. Verdict: pass.
